rows.Origin: Introduced in Netherlands by Interplant BV in 2015 as 'Fancy Ruffle'.
rows.Bloom: Pink, lighter reverse, ages to fuchsia / magenta . Moderate, fruity fragrance. 45 to 55 petals. Average diameter 3.5". Large, very full (41+ petals), ruffled bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
